title: Rabbi Achai bar Chanina (a Tanna of a Baraita)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 79b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.79b.4), Rabbi Acha speaks in his name. Hyman also cites Menachot 32a. In [Berakhot 2b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.2b.13), the name is Rabbi Achai or, according to another version, Rabbi Acha.[^1]

notes.text: In Shabbat Rabbi Acha cites Rabbi Achai bar Chanina, with Rabbi Yaakov beRabbi Chanina given as the alternative. Berakhot separately gives Achai or Acha. The named attribution was not found in the checked Menachot 32a.
